ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) background with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white/light gray) mottling and streaks across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-frequency white/gray stippling and mottling across the entirety of both lobes; dense, high-contrast white linear clusters (rake marks) situated on the lower-left lobe proximal to the notch; gray/white focal patches concentrated along the central longitudinal axis of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate internal angle of 50-55 degrees; well-defined vertex transitioning into the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations and deep scalloping; right lobe exhibits larger, more rhythmic undulations, while the left lobe shows smaller, more frequent jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broad convex curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips, with a slight upward taper at the furthest lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, roughly circular white pixel clusters scattered across the mid-to-outer right lobe and near the central notch area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of parallel, high-contrast white linear marks (rake marks) on the inner left lobe; additional random, non-parallel scratches visible across the mid-sections of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe jagged erosion and physical material loss at the distal tips of both lobes, resulting in a heavily traumatized profile; prominent linear rake marks on the left lobe inner quadrant.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme degree of fragmentation and irregular, 'shredded' profile of the distal lobe tips is the primary distinguishing feature.
